prompt:
Generate ONE coherent design-direction board, canvas approximately 1536x1152, containing THREE aligned mobile web screen states of the SAME interface, each with the natural proportions of a 390x844 viewport. This is NOT three different ideas in one image: the three states share identical branding, typography, spacing and layout. Make screen contents sharp, readable and large; simple narrow neutral gutters between screens. No device bezel, phone body, OS status bar, browser chrome or device shadow. Vietnamese language, Inter-style type with body 14-16px, touch targets 48px, control radius 8px and surface radius 10px. Current date is 05/10/2026; the pending utility billing period is September 2026, earlier payments are August and July 2026.

AUTHORITATIVE BRAND REFERENCE: attached actual logo from the current Electron app, an_khang_home_logo_ngang.png. Use this actual AK logo and exact name AN KHANG HOME; preserve its navy/green identity. Match the current Electron theme tokens exactly: primary #00AB60, dark #009653, shell/header #064A31, text #15231D, secondary text #718079, page #F7FAF8, mint #EDF9F1, separators #E5EEE8. Do not invent a replacement logo or rebrand. The attached logo is a branding asset, not a layout screenshot. EXACT REQUEST: design a compact tenant home AFTER sign-in, showing a short introduction to their own room, their own payment history if present, and an action leading to photographing BOTH electricity and water meters. This website exists for automated utility submission and payment, not landlord administration or room booking.

DESIGN DIRECTION: ROOM-FIRST: a small forest green brand header, airy white body, room name as strongest title, compact room fact rows, a mint utility submission area with one green CTA, understated history rows below. Clean linear vertical layout, restrained 10px radii, no excessive cards.

LEFT STATE, small board caption Khách đang thuê: tenant Nguyễn Minh Anh, Phòng 101, Tầng 1 · 22 m², current rent 3.000.000đ/tháng, current tenant's start date 01/07/2026. Clear current-cycle heading Điện nước tháng 09/2026 with status Chưa gửi ảnh; instruction Chụp công tơ để nhận hóa đơn. One primary action Chụp điện & nước with camera icon. A compact secondary section Lịch sử thanh toán with exactly two paid rows: Tháng 08/2026 — 3.245.000đ — Đã thanh toán; Tháng 07/2026 — 3.180.000đ — Đã thanh toán. Secondary link Xem chi tiết. All history belongs to this person's CURRENT contract only. No full dashboard, no room collection.

MIDDLE STATE, small board caption Khách mới: SAME home layout, tenant Trần Hoài Nam, Phòng 102, Tầng 1 · 22 m², CURRENT contract rent 3.000.000đ/tháng, start date 01/10/2026. Main current task Chụp công tơ bàn giao, short instruction Ghi nhận điện và nước khi nhận phòng, one primary Chụp điện & nước action. This is the first submission under a new contract. OMIT the history section entirely: do not show even an empty old-history list, old prices, old readings, old tenant's name, old photos, previous bills, previous rental periods, old debts, or any room data from previous occupants. Only show CURRENT room facts and this tenant's current contract. Do not print internal privacy rules or backend jargon on this page.

RIGHT STATE, small board caption Chụp công tơ: the next screen reached by the camera CTA. Header with back arrow and title Chụp điện & nước. Clear horizontal steps Điện active, Nước pending. Title Chụp công tơ điện, room 101 context, concise instruction Đặt dãy số vào khung. Central realistic utility-meter camera preview: simple installed mechanical/digital electric meter showing 01320, legible number reading frame, natural photographic look. Camera UI only inside preview, not device mock. Small helper Chụp rõ số, tránh lóa sáng. ONE dominant button Chụp ảnh điện. Small next-step text Tiếp theo: công tơ nước. This is capture before OCR, so do not display a fabricated final bill or verified OCR result. It must be clear that both meters are required, not just electricity.

Avoid: DBY Home branding, blue or terracotta primary buttons, gold/beige styling, purple gradients, invented room photos, landlord metrics, total properties, revenues, occupancy charts, navigation grids, admin login, tenant old-data disclosure, old index values in NEW tenant state, dense lists, tiny text, clipped Vietnamese labels, phone frames, QR payment on this home, Gmail badges or technical terms like contract_id, artificial marketing content, unnecessary bottom tabs. Three states of one cohesive direction only, each complete and unclipped.
